name: Akira
title: Chieftain of the tribe of Naphtali
summary: Akira, son of Enan, was the chieftain of the tribe of Naphtali during the wilderness journey. He presented his tribe's offerings at the dedication of the tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: Chieftain of Naphtali
keyEvents.description: Akira, son of Enan, was appointed as the chieftain of Naphtali and presented the tribe's offering at the dedication of the tabernacle.
